tables.name: ai_conversations
tables.comment: Groups AI messages and provider requests into one app-level conversation or generated workflow run.

columns.name: agent
columns.comment: Local agent or feature name that created this conversation.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Stable id for this AI conversation.

columns.name: metadata
columns.comment: Structured application metadata for this AI conversation.

columns.name: scope_id
columns.comment: Application-owned scope identifier, such as a team or project.

columns.name: title
columns.comment: Short human-readable title for debugging or future UI display.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Application user identifier, when available.

tables.name: ai_messages
tables.comment: Normalized AI conversation messages for prompts, assistant output, and tool messages.

columns.name: ai_request_id
columns.comment: Provider request that produced or used this message, when available.

columns.name: content
columns.comment: Text content for this AI message.

columns.name: content_json
columns.comment: Structured content for this AI message, when the response is not plain text.

columns.name: conversation_id
columns.comment: Conversation this message belongs to.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Stable id for this AI message.

columns.name: metadata
columns.comment: Structured application metadata for this message.

columns.name: model
columns.comment: AI model associated with this message.

columns.name: provider
columns.comment: AI provider associated with this message.

columns.name: role
columns.comment: Message role in the AI conversation.

columns.name: scope_id
columns.comment: Application-owned scope identifier, such as a team or project.

columns.name: sequence
columns.comment: Monotonic message order within the conversation.

columns.name: tool_call_id
columns.comment: Provider or SDK call id for a tool invocation represented by this message.

columns.name: tool_name
columns.comment: Tool name for tool-call messages.

columns.name: tool_state
columns.comment: Execution state for a tool-call message.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: Application user identifier, when available.

tables.name: ai_rate_limit_buckets
tables.comment: Current AI provider rate-limit state by provider endpoint and model/shared limit key; not a historical usage table.

columns.name: bucket_key
columns.comment: Stable provider:endpoint:limit-key identifier, for example openai:responses:gpt-5.4-nano.

columns.name: endpoint
columns.comment: Provider endpoint family this bucket tracks; responses and embeddings are separate limit pools.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Stable id for this rate-limit bucket.

columns.name: last_observed_at
columns.comment: Time this bucket was last updated from provider headers.

columns.name: last_provider_request_id
columns.comment: Most recent provider request id observed for this bucket.

columns.name: limit_key
columns.comment: Model or shared provider limit key used for throttling, not the app operation name.

columns.name: limit_project_tokens
columns.comment: Maximum project-scoped tokens allowed for the current provider window.

columns.name: limit_requests
columns.comment: Maximum requests allowed for the current provider window.

columns.name: limit_tokens
columns.comment: Maximum tokens allowed for the current provider window.

columns.name: metadata
columns.comment: Structured provider metadata for this bucket.

columns.name: project_tokens_reset_at
columns.comment: Time when the project token limit window should reset.

columns.name: provider
columns.comment: AI provider this bucket belongs to.

columns.name: remaining_project_tokens
columns.comment: Remaining project-scoped tokens from the latest provider headers before subtracting active reservations.

columns.name: remaining_requests
columns.comment: Remaining requests from the latest provider headers before subtracting active reservations.

columns.name: remaining_tokens
columns.comment: Remaining tokens from the latest provider headers before subtracting active reservations.

columns.name: requests_reset_at
columns.comment: Time when the request limit window should reset.

columns.name: tokens_reset_at
columns.comment: Time when the token limit window should reset.

tables.name: ai_rate_limit_reservations
tables.comment: Short-lived in-flight reservations subtracted from current AI rate-limit buckets.

columns.name: ai_request_id
columns.comment: Tracked AI request associated with this reservation, when available.

columns.name: bucket_id
columns.comment: Rate-limit bucket this reservation consumes capacity from.

columns.name: expires_at
columns.comment: Time this reservation stops counting if it is not explicitly released.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Stable id for this rate-limit reservation.

columns.name: operation
columns.comment: Application operation this reservation protects; bucket identity still comes from provider endpoint and limit key.

columns.name: released_at
columns.comment: Time this reservation was released after provider completion or failure.

columns.name: reserved_requests
columns.comment: Number of requests reserved against the bucket.

columns.name: reserved_tokens
columns.comment: Estimated tokens reserved against the bucket.

tables.name: ai_requests
tables.comment: Audit log of AI provider requests and responses, used for debugging generated analysis and content features.

columns.name: cache_write_tokens
columns.comment: Input tokens written into a billable provider prompt cache, when reported.

columns.name: cached_tokens
columns.comment: Cached input tokens reported by the provider, when available.

columns.name: completed_at
columns.comment: Time this request was completed.

columns.name: conversation_id
columns.comment: AI conversation that groups this provider request with normalized messages.

columns.name: cost_usd
columns.comment: Complete computed cost of this request in USD; null when any chargeable dimension is unpriced.

columns.name: duration_ms
columns.comment: Duration of this request in milliseconds.

columns.name: error_code
columns.comment: Error code for this request.

columns.name: error_message
columns.comment: Error message for this request.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Stable id for this AI request/response log entry.

columns.name: input_tokens
columns.comment: Number of input tokens used for this request.

columns.name: known_cost_usd
columns.comment: Known provider-cost subtotal in USD, including priced portions of an incompletely priced request.

columns.name: metadata
columns.comment: Structured application metadata for this request.

columns.name: model
columns.comment: AI model used for this request.

columns.name: operation
columns.comment: Provider operation used for this request.

columns.name: output_tokens
columns.comment: Number of output tokens used for this request.

columns.name: parent_ai_request_id
columns.comment: Immediate parent AI request that caused this request, used to total nested run costs without double counting.

columns.name: provider
columns.comment: AI provider used for this request.

columns.name: provider_processing_ms
columns.comment: Provider-reported processing duration in milliseconds.

columns.name: provider_request_id
columns.comment: Provider request id used for API troubleshooting.

columns.name: rate_limit_bucket_id
columns.comment: Current-state rate-limit bucket used for this provider request; per-request headers live in rate_limit_snapshot.

columns.name: rate_limit_snapshot
columns.comment: Parsed provider rate-limit headers captured for this request as an audit snapshot.

columns.name: reasoning_tokens
columns.comment: Reasoning output tokens reported by the provider, when available.

columns.name: request
columns.comment: Serialized request payload sent to the AI provider.

columns.name: response
columns.comment: Serialized response payload returned by the AI provider.

columns.name: started_at
columns.comment: Time this request was started.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Status of this request.

columns.name: total_tokens
columns.comment: Total tokens used for this request, when reported by the provider.

columns.name: failed_attempts
columns.comment: Consecutive wrong passwords for this identity.

columns.name: identity
columns.comment: Normalized submitted email or configured identity; null for legacy digest-only rows until their next attempt.

columns.name: identity_hash
columns.comment: SHA-256 of the normalized submitted identity; not tied to account existence.

columns.name: suspended_at
columns.comment: When password recovery became required; no automatic expiry.

columns.name: suspension_id
columns.comment: Unique suspension occurrence; prevents delayed recovery notices from referring to a later suspension.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: Latest password sign-in or recovery activity, including refused suspended attempts.

tables.name: auth_providers
tables.comment: Authentication provider linked to a user account. Password credentials and external login identities share this table.

columns.name: avatar_url
columns.comment: Avatar URL reported by the provider.

columns.name: email
columns.comment: Email address reported or proven by this provider.

columns.name: email_verified_at
columns.comment: When this provider proved the linked email address.

columns.name: label
columns.comment: Human-friendly label for settings screens.

columns.name: last_login_at
columns.comment: Last time this provider was used to authenticate.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Display name reported by the provider.

columns.name: password
columns.comment: Password hash for the built-in password provider. Null for external providers.

columns.name: profile_json
columns.comment: Safe provider metadata captured during verification.

columns.name: provider
columns.comment: Stable provider name such as password, google, or magic_link.

columns.name: provider_user_id
columns.comment: Stable provider-owned user id. For password this is the normalized email address.

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: User account this authentication provider belongs to.

columns.name: browser
columns.comment: Parsed browser name used for account session displays.

columns.name: device
columns.comment: Parsed device model or category used for account session displays.

columns.name: ip_address
columns.comment: Latest client IP address observed while this session was active.

columns.name: operating_system
columns.comment: Parsed operating-system name used for account session displays.

columns.name: revoked_at
columns.comment: When this bearer session was explicitly revoked.

columns.name: user_agent
columns.comment: Raw client user-agent captured when this session was created.

tables.name: scheduled_occurrences
tables.comment: Durable scheduler claims and lifecycle state for registered task occurrences.

columns.name: attempts
columns.comment: Number of queue processing attempts observed.

columns.name: claimed_at
columns.comment: Time at which a scheduler process won this occurrence claim.

columns.name: dispatched_at
columns.comment: Time at which the queue accepted the scheduled job.

columns.name: finished_at
columns.comment: Terminal scheduler or queue completion time.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Stable scheduled occurrence ULID.

columns.name: job_name
columns.comment: Durable queue job name for job occurrences.

columns.name: kind
columns.comment: Whether this occurrence dispatches a job or runs an inline call.

columns.name: last_error
columns.comment: Most recent dispatch, callback, retry, or terminal failure.

columns.name: max_tries
columns.comment: Maximum queue attempts configured for this job.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Stable registered schedule name used for deduplication.

columns.name: next_attempt_at
columns.comment: Expected availability time after a retry or deferral.

columns.name: queue_job_id
columns.comment: Driver-owned queue job id after dispatch.

columns.name: queue_job_uuid
columns.comment: Stable queue UUID retained across job attempts.

columns.name: scheduled_for
columns.comment: Canonical UTC minute represented by this occurrence.

columns.name: started_at
columns.comment: First worker claim or inline callback start time.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Current scheduler or queue lifecycle state.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: Most recent lifecycle state change.

columns.name: avatar_url
columns.comment: Account avatar URL. External providers may supply the initial value, while the account owns later changes.
